en: Psalms 38
A Psalm by David, for a memorial.

p.src: 1  LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

en: LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.
u.src: 1  LORD, don’t rebuke me in your wrath, neither chasten me in your hot displeasure.

p.src: 2  For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

en: For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.
u.src: 2  For your arrows have pierced me, your hand presses hard on me.

p.src: 3  There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.
u.src: 3  There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation, neither is there any health in my bones because of my sin.

p.src: 4  For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

en: For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.
u.src: 4  For my iniquities have gone over my head. As a heavy burden, they are too heavy for me.

p.src: 5  My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

en: My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.
u.src: 5  My wounds are loathsome and corrupt because of my foolishness.

p.src: 6  I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

en: I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.
u.src: 6  I am in pain and bowed down greatly. I go mourning all day long.

p.src: 7  For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

en: For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.
u.src: 7  For my waist is filled with burning. There is no soundness in my flesh.

p.src: 8  I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

en: I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.
u.src: 8  I am faint and severely bruised. I have groaned by reason of the anguish of my heart.

p.src: 9  Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

en: Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.
u.src: 9  Lord, all my desire is before you. My groaning is not hidden from you.

p.src: 10  My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

en: My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.
u.src: 10  My heart throbs. My strength fails me. As for the light of my eyes, it has also left me.

p.src: 11  My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

en: My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.
u.src: 11  My lovers and my friends stand aloof from my plague. My kinsmen stand far away.

p.src: 12  They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

en: They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.
u.src: 12  They also who seek after my life lay snares. Those who seek my hurt speak mischievous things, and meditate deceits all day long.

p.src: 13  But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

en: But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.
u.src: 13  But I, as a deaf man, don’t hear. I am as a mute man who doesn’t open his mouth.

p.src: 14  Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

en: Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.
u.src: 14  Yes, I am as a man who doesn’t hear, in whose mouth are no reproofs.

p.src: 15  For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.

en: For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.
u.src: 15  For I hope in you, LORD. You will answer, Lord my God.

p.src: 16  For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

en: For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”
u.src: 16  For I said, “Don’t let them gloat over me, or exalt themselves over me when my foot slips.”

p.src: 17  For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

en: For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.
u.src: 17  For I am ready to fall. My pain is continually before me.

p.src: 18  For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

en: For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.
u.src: 18  For I will declare my iniquity. I will be sorry for my sin.

p.src: 19  But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

en: But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.
u.src: 19  But my enemies are vigorous and many. Those who hate me without reason are numerous.

p.src: 20  They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

en: They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.
u.src: 20  They who give evil for good are also adversaries to me, because I follow what is good.

p.src: 21  Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.

en: Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.
u.src: 21  Don’t forsake me, LORD. My God, don’t be far from me.

p.src: 22  Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.

en: Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
u.src: 22  Hurry to help me, Lord, my salvation.
